fields.name: runtimeAdjustments
fields.tooltip: Master switch. Off = every effect below holds its baseline, whatever gameplay asks for.

fields.name: lensRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: motionBlurRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: motionBlurClampRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the longest blur streak, as a fraction of the screen).

fields.name: bloomRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: vignetteRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: chromaticRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: filmGrainRange
fields.tooltip: Band a runtime request is clamped to (the override's intensity).

fields.name: glitchRange
fields.tooltip: Band the glitch intensity is clamped to while gameplay drives it.

fields.name: distanceFogRange
fields.tooltip: Band the fog intensity is clamped to while gameplay ramps it off its asset value.

fields.name: speedLinesRange
fields.tooltip: Band the speed-line intensity is clamped to while the speed or a boost drives it.

fields.name: vhsRange
fields.tooltip: Band the tape intensity is clamped to while gameplay ramps it off its asset value. The player's VIDEO dial multiplies in afterwards.

fields.name: psxRange
fields.tooltip: Band the console intensity is clamped to while gameplay ramps it off its asset value. The player's VIDEO dial multiplies in afterwards.

fields.name: crtRange
fields.tooltip: Band the tube intensity is clamped to while gameplay ramps it off its asset value. The player's VIDEO dial multiplies in afterwards.

fields.name: hyperspaceRange
fields.tooltip: Band the sky crossfade is clamped to while Light Speed holds it in.

fields.name: rainAtmosphereRange
fields.tooltip: Band the rain's fog and ambient dimming is clamped to.
